policy.final_held_out_outcome_access: After capture, recording-integrity checks may inspect topics, duration, timestamps, and corruption only. Do not inspect TIM outcomes or change thresholds until all final held-out bags, annotations, participant codes, clothing codes, and hashes are frozen.
policy.threshold_change_after_final_access: Create a new split version and treat the accessed final set as development data. It may not support the final held-out claim.
policy.legacy_validation_use: Diagnostic comparison only. Do not tune on it and do not call it held-out.
policy.algorithm_change_after_freeze: Before held-out outcome access, any deliberate behavior-affecting TIM, tracker, Target-ReID, model, or threshold change requires an explicitly versioned new prospective freeze. After held-out outcome access, a change made in response to those outcomes contaminates the accessed recordings; they cannot remain final held-out evidence.
policy.allowed_pre_outcome_inspection: Allowed before release: source recording integrity, topic presence, duration, timestamps, corruption, image quality sufficient for annotation, physical-person annotation, participant/outfit coding, and provenance. Forbidden before release: TIM correctness, candidate scores, comparative architecture outcomes, threshold diagnostics, or any result used to choose an algorithm/model/configuration.
policy.annotation_or_data_defect: A source or annotation defect may be corrected only independently of algorithm outcomes, with the correction documented, re-versioned where needed, and all affected hashes regenerated before final evaluation.
policy.implementation_defect_after_final_access: Stop evaluation and document the defect. Do not quietly patch and rerun. Determine explicitly whether the accessed held-out recordings have influenced the fix. If they have, those recordings are contaminated and must leave the final held-out set before any new final claim.
policy.final_evaluation_use: Final held-out data may compare only systems, thresholds, tracker settings, models, and evaluation rules frozen before held-out outcome access.
policy.post_freeze_lock: Once this v4 freeze is merged, the first access or capture of any of H01/H02/H03 locks the algorithm, production configuration, tracker configuration, models, evaluator definitions, split, architecture arms, primary metrics and annotation interpretation. No outcome-driven change to any of these is permitted afterward. A serious software correctness bug discovered after held-out access must be documented; it may not be silently patched and re-run as though still prospective, and any corrected evaluation must be identified as post-freeze/post-access evidence. A failed algorithmic performance result is never grounds for recapture or for a contract change.

freeze.freeze_reason: The 5 September v3 prospective freeze was superseded before any H01-H03 capture or outcome access because the reviewed Stage-1 mechanism-ablation campaign selected one behaviour-affecting promotion, AB-16 source-aware adaptive positive-memory updates (appearance_prevent_repeated_source_adaptive_update=true). It was merged as PR #101 at 79f11b631688889bf5ffbeb3c16ef543a53f9973 with development regression evidence docs/results/selected_target_tracking/tim_mars_ab16_production_regression_20260908.{md,json}. This v4 freeze binds the resulting final canonical algorithm and configuration prospectively. H01-H03 membership and scenarios are unchanged and no held-out outcome has been captured or accessed. AB-14, AB-15 and AB-19 are not promoted; no threshold was tuned. This is a protocol update, not post-test tuning.

prospective_freeze_manifest.note: Companion machine-readable manifest pinning the full reproduction surface (models, pinned numerical environment, evaluation tooling, runtime-provenance requirements, primary and presence-conditioned metric contract, and the post-freeze lock rule).

freeze.provenance_model_note: freeze.algorithm_commit (79f11b631688889bf5ffbeb3c16ef543a53f9973) is the immutable algorithm/configuration authority and is NOT the runtime git HEAD of a Stage-7 evaluation. freeze_definition_commit (1b38a8cc27188e94b1c08ff6d555712cec752ed9) is the Stage-7 contract root on branch p027-prospective-freeze-20260908. A held-out runtime revision records its actual HEAD and is valid when it contains the merged Stage-7 freeze and keeps every final_comparison_contract source_code_freeze.required_unchanged_paths path and every pinned artifact byte-identical to the algorithm authority. See docs/results/selected_target_tracking/tim_mars_prospective_freeze_20260908.json provenance_model.
